title: Scheme-theoretic union of two closed subschemes
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $i':Z'\to X$, $i'':Z''\to X$ be closed immersions [def-weil-closed-immersion] with ideal sheaves $\mathcal I'=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i'_*\mathcal O_{Z'})$ and $\mathcal I''=\ker(\mathcal O_X\to i''_*\mathcal O_{Z''})$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Then $\mathcal I'\cap\mathcal I''$ is a quasi-coherent sheaf of ideals of $\mathcal O_X$; let $i''':Z'''\to X$ be the closed immersion it defines (the *scheme-theoretic union* $Z'\cup Z''$; on an affine open $U=\operatorname{Spec}A$ of $X$ [def-weil-affine-spectrum] where $Z'\cap U$, $Z''\cap U$ are cut out by ideals $I,J\subseteq A$ it is $\operatorname{Spec}(A/(I\cap J))\to\operatorname{Spec}A$). Then: (a) the underlying set $i'''(Z''')$ equals $i'(Z')\cup i''(Z'')$; (b) there are closed immersions $a':Z'\to Z'''$ and $a'':Z''\to Z'''$ with $i'''\circ a'=i'$ and $i'''\circ a''=i''$.

source.place: Morphisms, Definition 0C4H (definition-scheme-theoretic-intersection-union) and Lemma 0C4J (lemma-scheme-theoretic-union), first sentence and the affine-local description in its proof ($(X\cup Y)\cap U$ corresponds to $I\cap J$); closed immersions via Lemma 01QP (lemma-closed-immersion-ideals, cited in the proof of 0C4J); (a) from $V(I\cap J)=V(I)\cup V(J)$
